_about: v15 phone layout (work/xva, src/phone.js; notes/ui-redesign-2/build/phone.md): the strings it adds. id -> {en, ru, note}. Russian follows notes/i18n/GLOSSARY.md (Тема, Настройки, Поиск as in the glossary; buttons and menu rows are verbs or nouns, no final period). Read by tools/make_ru_table.py (v15-*.json).

v15ph.numbers.note: The chain bar's first chip on a phone when there are no shared numbers yet (phone/DESIGN.md 3.3: «Числа»); also its accessible name.

v15ph.numbers_list.note: Accessible name of the Numbers chip: the names of the shared numbers, comma-separated (a, ρ).

v15ph.theme.note: Row label in the phone's More sheet, followed by the Auto / Light / Dark switch (GLOSSARY: Тема: Авто / Светлая / Тёмная).

v15ph.settings.note: Link on the Sound row of the phone's More sheet: opens the sound settings (GLOSSARY: Настройки звука).

v15ph.this_view.note: Heading in the phone's Display sheet over the options of the open view (the ones the plane's sliders button held).

v15ph.resize.note: Accessible name of the bottom sheet's grabber: a tap toggles half and full height.

v15ph.show_large.note: Accessible name of the small inset plane on a phone: a tap swaps it with the large plane. {x} is X or Y (Latin, italic in the picture).

v15ph.search.note: Row in the phone's More sheet: opens the command palette (GLOSSARY: Поиск).

v15ph.links.note: Row in the phone's More sheet: opens the export menu (copy LaTeX, copy link, save and open scene files).
